user.title: Heating Schedule
user.description: How many rooms do you want to schedule? You can change this later by removing and re-adding the integration.

room.title: Room {index} of {total}
room.description: Pick a name and the climate entity for this room. The optional sensor and window entries drive the current-temperature subtitle and the open-window icon on the card.

globals.title: Setback and pause
globals.description: Optionally hook into an existing pause helper, and pick a setback temperature for the hours outside any window.

summary.title: Add the cards to your dashboard
summary.description:
Setup is ready. Add the card as a Lovelace resource (Settings → Dashboards → Resources):

- URL `/heating_schedule/heating-window-slider-card.js`
- Type *JavaScript module*

Then paste this YAML into a sections-style view:

```yaml
{dashboard_yaml}
```

Click **Submit** to finish.
